mentions.name: Aivi
mentions.description: This service posts live activities to mobile devices (iOS to begin with), enabling glanceable progress indicators for connected home appliances. It was motivated by the author's Bosch dishwasher, which lacks a quick way to see cycle progress, and is being shaped into a usable tool for home automation tinkerers.
mentions.problem: Connected appliances like Bosch dishwashers lack a glanceable indication of cycle progress, and the manufacturer's app takes too long to check progress to be useful.
mentions.audience: A service for home automation tinkerers who want glanceable status from connected appliances.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building a simple service that allows one to post live activities to mobile devices (iOS to begin with).

evidence.value: Building a simple service that allows one to post live activities to mobile devices (iOS to begin with).
